7:0.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا تَعْلَمُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا تَعْلَمُ وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ مِنْ كُلِّ مَا تَعْلَمُ إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ وَلَا نَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ
7:0.tr: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka min khayri mā taʿlamu, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā taʿlamu, wa astaghfiruka min kulli mā taʿlamu, innaka taʿlamu wa lā naʿlamu, wa anta ʿallāmu l-ghuyūb.
7:0.en: O Allah, I do entreat Thee for some of the good that Thou knowest, and I appeal to Thee against the evil that Thou knowest, and I entreat Thee for pardon for all that Thou knowest; for Thou knowest and we do not know, and Thou art above all Learned in Secrets.

7:1.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ ارْحَمْنِي مِنْ زَمَانِي هٰذَا وَإِحْدَاقِ الْفِتَنِ وَتَطَاوُلِ أَهْلِ الْجُرْأَةِ عَلَيَّ وَاسْتِضْعَافِهِمْ إِيَّايَ
7:1.tr: Allāhumma irḥamnī min zamānī hādhā wa iḥdāqi l-fitani, wa taṭāwuli ahli l-jurāʾati ʿalayya wa istisḍʿāfihim īyāya.
7:1.en: O Allah, have mercy on me in times of my encirclement in discomforts and save me from the oppression of the tyrants so exceedingly cruel.

7:2.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنْكَ فِي عِيَاذٍ مَنِيعٍ، وَحِرْزٍ حَصِينٍ، مِنْ جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ حَتَّى تُبَلِّغَنِي أَجَلِي مُعَافًى
7:2.tr: Allāhumma ajʿalnī minka fī ʿiyādin manīʿin, wa ḥirzin ḥaṣīnin, min jamīʿi khalqika ḥattā tuballighanī ajalī muʿāfā.
7:2.en: O Allah, place me for Thyself in secure protection and a strong refuge from all Thy creation, until Thou enablest me to reach the most transcendent eminence.

7:3.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا تَنْبَغِي الصَّلَاةُ عَلَيْهِ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا تَجِبُ الصَّلَاةُ عَلَيْهِ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا أَمَرْتَ أَنْ ‖ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِ نِ الَّذِي نُورُهُ مِنْ نُورِ الْأَنْوَارِ، وَأَشْرَقَ بِشُعَاعِ سِرِّهِ الْأَسْرَارُ
7:3.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada man ṣallā ʿalayhi, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada man lam yuṣalli ʿalayhi, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā tanbaghī ṣ-ṣalātu ʿalayhi, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā tajibu ṣ-ṣalātu ʿalayhi, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā amarta an yuṣallā ʿalayhi, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī nūruhu min nūri l-anwār, wa ashraqa bi-shuʿāʿi sirrihi l-asrār.
7:3.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, in every one who blesses him; and bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, in every one who does not bless him; and bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad even as the blessing is suited to him; and bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, even as the blessing is needful for him; and bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, even as Thou hast ordained that he shall be blessed; and bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, whose Light is from the Light of Lights, and enlighten his inmost secret thoughts with rays of brightness.

7:4.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ الْأَبْرَارِ أَجْمَعِينَ
7:4.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā ahli baytihi l-abrār ajmaʿīn.
7:4.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, and the men of his Household, most upright of all, every one of them.

7:5.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ بَحْرِ أَنْوَارِكَ، وَمَعْدِنِ أَسْرَارِكَ، وَلِسَانِ حُجَّتِكَ، وَعَرُوسِ مَمْلَكَتِكَ، وَإِمَامِ حَضْرَتِكَ، وَخَاتِمِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ، صَلَاةً تَدُومُ بِدَوَامِكَ، وَتَبْقَى بِبَقَائِكَ، صَلَاةً تُرْضِيكَ وَتُرْضِيهِ، وَتَرْضَى بِهَا عَنَّا يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ
7:5.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā ālihi baḥri anwārika, wa maʿdini asrārika, wa lisāni ḥujjatika, wa ʿarusi mamlakatika, wa imāmi ḥaḍratika, wa khātami anbiyāʾika, ṣalātan tadūmu bi-dawāmika wa tabqā bi-baqāʾika, ṣalātan turḍīka wa turḍīhi, wa tarḍā bihā ʿannā yā rabba l-ʿālamīn.
7:5.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and his Family, the Sea of Thy Brightness, and the Mine of Thy Secrets, and the Voice of Thy Arguments, and the Bridegroom of Thy Royalty, and the Imam of Thy Presence, and the Seal of Thy Prophets; a blessing that will last whilst Thou endurest, and will survive while Thou survivest: a blessing that will find favour with Thee, and will find favour with him, and will bring favour to me through it for ourselves; O Thou Most Compassionate, Most Merciful: O Thou Lord of the Worlds.

7:6.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّ الْحِلِّ وَالْحَرَمِ، وَرَبَّ الْمَشْعَرِ الْحَرَامِ، وَرَبَّ الْبَيْتِ الْحَرَامِ، وَرَبَّ الرُّكْنِ وَالمَقَامِ أَبْلِغْ لِسَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِنَّا السَّلَامَ
7:6.tr: Allāhumma rabba l-ḥilli wa l-ḥaram, wa rabba l-mashʿari l-ḥarām, wa rabba l-bayti l-ḥarām, wa rabba r-rukni wa l-maqām, abliġ li-sayyidina wa mawlana muhammadin minnas salaam.
7:6.en: O Allah, Lord of whatever is Allowed, Lord of whatever is Forbidden, Lord of the Sacred Precinct, Lord of the Sacred House, and Lord of Stone of Support, and the Place of Honour, cause this salutation of peace to reach our master and patron Muhammad from us.

7:7.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ سَيِّدِ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَالآخِرِينَ
7:7.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin sayyidi l-awwalīna wa l-ākhirīn.
7:7.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad, our master of the First and the Last.

7:8.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي كُلِّ وَقْتٍ وَحِينٍ
7:8.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlāna Muḥammadin fī kulli waqtin wa ḥī.
7:8.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad at every time and moment.

7:9.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ ‖ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْمَلَإِ الْأَعْلَى إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ
7:9.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin fī l-malaʾi l-aʿlā ilā yawm ad-dīn.
7:9.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in the higher assembly of angels, until the Day of Judgement.

7:10.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى تَرِثَ الْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ
7:10.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ḥattā taritha l-arḍa wa man ʿalayhā wa anta khayru l-wārithīn.
7:10.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad until Thou art the Heir of the earth, and whoever there is on it; for Thou art the best of heirs.

7:11.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِ نِ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَّجِيدٌ ۞ وَبَارِكْ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَّجِيدٌ
7:11.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nabiyyi l-ummī wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā ṣallayta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīm, innaka ḥamīdun majīd, wa bārik ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nabiyyi l-ummī kamā bārakta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīm, innaka ḥamīdun majīd.
7:11.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad the Unlettered Prophet and the Family of our master Muhammad, even as Thou didst bless our master Abraham, for Thou art Laudable and Glorious; and show favour to our master Muhammad the Unlettered Prophet, even as Thou didst with our master Abraham, for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.

7:12.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ، وَجَرَى بِهِ قَلَمُكَ، وَسَبَقَتْ بِهِ مَشِيئَتُكَ، وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْهِ مَلَائِكَتُكَ، صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً بِدَوَامِكَ، بَاقِيَةً بِفَضْلِكَ وَإِحْسَانِكَ، إِلَى أَبَدِ الْأَبَدِ، أَبَدًا، لَا نِهَايَةَ لِأَبَدِيَّتِهِ، وَلَا فَنَاءَ لِدَيْمُومِيَّتِهِ
7:12.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā aḥāṭa bihi ʿilmuka, wa jarā bihi qalamuka, wa sabaqat bihi mashīʾatuka, wa ṣallat ʿalayhi malāʾikatuka, ṣalātan dāʾimatan bi-dawāmika, bāqiyatan bi-faḍlika wa iḥsānika, ilā abad al-abad, lā nihāyata li-abadiyyatihā wa lā fanāʾa li-daymūmiyyatih.
7:12.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad in all that Thy Knowledge includes or Thy Pen has covered, or to which Thy Will extends, or Thy angels bless: in a blessing that lasts as long as Thou endurest, and continues in Thy Grace and Thy Goodness, through all the length of time for ever; for there is no limit to his endurance, and there is no finality of his continuance.

7:13.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ ‖ عِلْمُكَ، وَأَحْصَاهُ كِتَابُكَ، وَشَهِدَتْ بِهِ مَلَائِكَتُكَ، وَارْضَ عَنْ أَصْحَابِهِ، وَارْحَمْ أُمَّتَهُ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَّجِيدٌ
7:13.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā aḥāṭa bihi ʿilmuka wa aḥṣāhu kitābuka wa shahidat bihi malāʾikatuka, wa-rḍa ʿan aṣḥābihi wa irḥam ummatahu innaka ḥamīdun majīd.
7:13.en: O Allah, bless our master and Patron Muhammad, and the Family of our master Muhammad, in all that Thy knowledge includes, and Thy Book recounts, or that Thy angels and earth testify of his Comrades, and have mercy on his religion, for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.

7:14.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى جَمِيعِ أَصْحَابِ سَيِّدِنَا مُّحَمَّدٍ
7:14.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā jamīʿi aṣḥābihi sayyidinā Muḥammad.
7:14.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, and all the Comrades of our master Muhammad.

7:15.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَبَارِكْ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي الْعَالَمِينَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَّجِيدٌ
7:15.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā ṣallayta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīm, wa bārik ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā bārakta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīm wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Ibrāhīm fī l-ʿālamīn innaka ḥamīdun majīd.
7:15.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, as Thou didst bless our master Abraham, and show favour, O Allah, on our master Muhammad and on the Family of our master Muhammad, as Thou didst toward our master Abraham and the Family of our master Abraham in the world at large; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.

7:16.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ بِخُشُوعِ الْقَلْبِ عِندَ السُّجُودِ لَكَ يَا سَيِّدِي بِغَيْرِ جُحُودٍ وَبِكَ يَا اللّٰهُ يَا جَلِيلُ فَلَا شَيْءَ يُدَانِيكَ فِي غَلِيظِ الْعُهُودِ وَبِكُرْسِيِّكَ الْمُكَلَّلِ بِالنُّورِ إِلَى عَرْشِكَ الْعَظِيمِ الْمَجِيدِ ۞ وَبِمَا كَانَ تَحْتَ عَرْشِكَ حَقًّا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَخْلُقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَصَوْتَ الرُّعُودِ لَكَ إِذْ كُنْتَ مِثْلَ مَا لَمْ تَزَلْ قَطُّ إِلٰهًا عُرِفْتَ بِالتَّوْحِيدِ فَاجْعَلْنِي ‖ مِنَ الْمُحِبِّينَ الْمَحْبُوبِينَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ الْعَارِفِيْنَ الْعَاشِقِينَ لَكَ يَا اللّٰهُ يَا اللّٰهُ يَا اللّٰهُ يَا اللّٰهُ يَا اللّٰهُ يَا اللّٰهُ يَا اللّٰهُ يَا اللّٰهُ يَا وَدُودُ
7:16.tr: Allāhumma bi-khushūʿi l-qalbi ʿinda s-sujūd laka yā sayyidī bi-ghayri juḥūd wa bika yā Allāhu yā Jalīl fa-lā shayʾa yudānīka fī ghalīẓi l-ʿuhūd, wa bi-kursiyyika l-mukallali bi-n-nūr ilā ʿarshika l-ʿaẓīm al-majīd, wa bimā kāna taḥta ʿarshika ḥaqqan qabla an takhlaqa s-samāwāti wa ṣawta r-raʿūdi laka idh kunta mithla mā lam tazal qaṭṭ ilāhan ʿurifta bi-t-tawḥīd, fajʿalnī mina l-muḥibbīn al-maḥbūbīn al-muqarrabīn al-ʿārifīn al-ʿāshiqīn laka yā Allāhu yā Allāhu yā Allāhu yā Allāhu yā Allāhu yā Allāhu yā Allāhu yā Allāhu yā Wadūd.
7:16.en: O Allah, from the core of the heart humbly prostrating before Thee; O Allah, with no unbelief at all and for Thy sake and O Allah, the Sublime! nothing can match Thee in inviolable promises; and for the sake of Thy Footstool adorned with light to the expanse of Thy Mighty and Powerful Throne and for the sake of that which lay beneath Thy Throne before Thou didst create the heavens and the sound of Thy thunder; Thou art Infinite, Thou art without any parallel, the Singular; I implore to make me one of Thy favourites, Thy beloved ones, Thy near ones and one of Thy ardent lovers, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O Thou the Bestower.

7:17.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ
7:17.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Sayyidinā wa Mawlana Muḥammadin ʿadada mā aḥāṭa bihi ʿilmuka.
7:17.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad, in all that Thy Knowledge includes.

7:18.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَحْصَاهُ كِتَابُكَ
7:18.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Sayyidinā wa Mawlana Muḥammadin ʿadada mā aḥṣāhu kitābuka.
7:18.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in all that the Book recounts.

7:19.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا نَفَذَتْ بِهِ قُدْرَتُكَ
7:19.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Sayyidinā wa Mawlana Muḥammadin ʿadada mā nafadhat bihi qudratuka.
7:19.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in as much as he is distinguished by Thy Will.

7:20.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَصَّصَتْهُ إِرَادَتُكَ
7:20.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Sayyidinā wa Mawlana Muḥammadin ʿadada mā khaṣṣaṣtahu irādatuka.
7:20.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in everything that Thy Will authorizes.

7:21.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا تَوَجَّهَ إِلَيْهِ أَمْرُكَ وَنَهْيُكَ
7:21.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Sayyidinā wa Mawlana Muḥammadin ʿadada mā tawajjaha ilayhi amruka wa nahyuka.
7:21.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in all that Thy Command or Thy Refusal has in view.

7:22.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا وَسِعَهُ سَمْعُكَ
7:22.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Sayyidinā wa Mawlana Muḥammadin ʿadada mā wasiʿahu samʿuka.
7:22.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in everything that is within Thy Hearing.

7:23.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ بَصَرُكَ
7:23.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Sayyidinā wa Mawlana Muḥammadin ʿadada mā aḥāṭa bihi baṣaruka.
7:23.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in everything to which Thy Power of Sight extends.

7:24.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا ذَكَرَهُ الذَّاكِرُونَ
7:24.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Sayyidinā wa Mawlana Muḥammadin ʿadada mā dhakarahudh-dhākirūn.
7:24.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in everything that those who record Thy works record.

7:25.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ ‖ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا غَفَلَ عَنْ ذِكْرِهِ الْغَافِلُونَ
7:25.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Sayyidinā wa Mawlana Muḥammadin ʿadada mā ghafala ʿan dhikrihi l-ghāfilūn.
7:25.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in all that they who are neglectful neglect to record.

7:26.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ قَطْرِ الْأَمْطَارِ
7:26.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Sayyidinā wa Mawlana Muḥammadin ʿadada qaṭri l-amṭār.
7:26.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in every shower of rain.

7:27.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ أَوْرَاقِ الْأَشْجَارِ
7:27.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ʿadada awrāqi l-ashjār.
7:27.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in all the leaves of the trees.

7:28.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ دَوَابِّ الْقِفَارِ
7:28.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ʿadada dawābbi l-qifār.
7:28.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in all the expanse of the dry land.

7:29.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ دَوَابِّ الْبِحَارِ
7:29.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ʿadada dawābbi l-biḥār.
7:29.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in all the expanse of the sea.

7:30.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مِيَاهِ الْبِحَارِ
7:30.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ʿadada miyāhi l-biḥār.
7:30.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in all the waters of the sea.

7:31.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلُ وَأَضَاءَ عَلَيْهِ النَّهَارُ
7:31.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā aẓlama ʿalayhil-laylu wa aḍāʾa ʿalayhi n-nahār.
7:31.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in everything on which night throws its darkness, or light its brightness.

7:32.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالْآصَالِ
7:32.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin bi-l-ghudūwi wa l-āṣāl.
7:32.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in the morning and in the evening.

7:33.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الرِّمَالِ
7:33.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ʿadada r-rimāl.
7:33.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad through all the sandy plains.

7:34.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ النِّسَاءِ وَالرِّجَالِ
7:34.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ʿadada an-nisāʾi wa r-rijāl.
7:34.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad among all women and men.

7:35.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا ‖ وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ رِضَاءَ نَفْسِكَ
7:35.tr: Allahumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin riḍāʾa nafsik.
7:35.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad as Thy Soul pleaseth.

7:36.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِكَ
7:36.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin midāda kalimātik.
7:36.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in the form of Thy Words.

7:37.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِلْءَ سَمَاوَاتِكَ وَأَرْضِكَ
7:37.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin milʾa samāwātika wa arḍik.
7:37.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in the fullness of Thy heavens and Thy earth.

7:38.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ زِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ
7:38.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin zina ta ʿarshik.
7:38.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in the beauty of Thy Throne.

7:39.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَخْلُوقَاتِكَ
7:39.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ʿadada makhlūqātik.
7:39.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in all Thy created things.

7:40.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ أَفْضَلَ صَلَوَاتِكَ
7:40.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin afḍala ṣalawātik.
7:40.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad with the most gracious of Thy blessings.

7:41.en: O Allah, bless the Prophet of mercy.

7:42.en: O Allah, bless the advocate of the faith.

7:43.en: O Allah, bless him who takes away grief.

7:44.en: O Allah, bless him who enlightens darkness.

7:45.en: O Allah, bless the lord of pleasure.

7:46.en: O Allah, bless the giver of mercy.

7:47.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى صَاحِبِ الْحَوْضِ الْمَوْرُودِ
7:47.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibi l-ḥawḍi l-mawrūd.
7:47.en: O Allah, bless the owner of the conduit cistern.

7:48.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى صَاحِبِ الْمَقَامِ الْمَحْمُودِ
7:48.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibi l-maqāmi l-maḥmūd.
7:48.en: O Allah, bless the claimant of the honoured place.

7:49.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى صَاحِبِ اللِّوَاءِ الْمَعْقُودِ
7:49.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibi l-liwāʾi l-maʿqūd.
7:49.en: O Allah, bless the hero of the knotted standard.

7:50.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى صَاحِبِ الْمَكَانِ ‖ الْمَشْهُودِ
7:50.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibi l-makāni l-mashhūd.
7:50.en: O Allah, bless the man of the acknowledged sojourn.

7:51.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى الْمَوْصُوفِ بِالْكَرَمِ وَالجُودِ
7:51.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā l-mawṣūfi bi-l-karami wa l-jūd.
7:51.en: O Allah, bless him who was adorned by nobleness and generosity.

7:52.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مَنْ هُوَ فِي السَّمَاءِ سَيِّدُنَا مَحْمُودٌ، وَفِي الْأَرْضِ سَيِّدُنَا مُحَمَّدٌ
7:52.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man huwa fī s-samāʾ sayyidinā Maḥmūd wa fī l-arḍ sayyidinā Muḥammad.
7:52.en: O Allah, bless him who in heaven is Mahmood, and on earth Muhammad.

7:53.en: O Allah, bless the man with the mole.

7:54.en: O Allah, bless the one who possessed distinguishing mark.

7:55.en: O Allah, bless the man endued with miracles.

7:56.en: O Allah, bless the man the object of veneration.

7:57.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مَنْ كَانَ تُظِلُّهُ الْغَمَامَةُ
7:57.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man kāna tuẓilluhu l-ghamāma.
7:57.en: O Allah, bless the man who was shaded by clouds.

7:58.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مَنْ كَانَ يَرَى مَنْ خَلْفَهُ كَمَا يَرَى مَنْ أَمَامَهُ
7:58.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man kāna yarā man khalfahu kamā yarā man amāma.
7:58.en: O Allah, bless him who saw everything from behind, even as could see one who was in front of him.

7:59.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى الشَّفِيعِ الْمُشَفَّعِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
7:59.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sh-shafīʿi l-mushaffaʿi yawma l-qiyāma.
7:59.en: O Allah, bless the one whose intercession is accepted in the Day of Resurrection.

7:60.en: O Allah, bless the example of humility.

7:61.en: O Allah, bless the votary of intercession.

7:62.en: O Allah, bless the promoter of good influence.

7:63.en: O Allah, bless the man of gracious mind.

7:64.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى صَاحِبِ الدَّرَجَةِ الرَّفِيعَةِ
7:64.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibi d-darajati r-rafīʿa.
7:64.en: O Allah, bless the model of exalted dignity.

7:65.en: O Allah, bless the man of the stalwart staff.

7:66.en: O Allah, bless the man who wore his sandals.

7:67.en: O Allah, bless the man of argument.

7:68.en: O Allah, bless the man of sound reason.

7:69.en: O Allah, bless the man of power.

7:70.en: O Allah, bless the wearer of the turban.

7:71.en: O Allah, bless the hero of the night ascent.

7:72.en: O Allah, bless the hero of the sword.

7:73.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā rāki bi n-najīb.
7:73.en: O Allah, bless the noble rider.

7:74.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā rāki bi l-burāq.
7:74.en: O Allah, bless the rider of Borak.

7:75.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُخْتَرِقِ السَّبْعِ الطِّبَاقِ
7:75.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā mukhtariqi s-sabʿi ṭ-ṭibāq.
7:75.en: O Allah, bless him who traversed the seven spheres.

7:76.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى الشَّفِيعِ فِي جَمِيعِ الْأَنَامِ
7:76.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sh-shafīʿi fī jamīʿi l-anām.
7:76.en: O Allah, bless the intercessor for all creatures.

7:77.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مَنْ سَبَّحَ فِي كَفِّهِ الطَّعَامُ
7:77.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man sabbaḥa fī kaffihi ṭ-ṭaʿām.
7:77.en: O Allah, bless the man who held food in his hand and which glorified Allah.

7:78.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مَنْ بَكَى إِلَيْهِ الْجِذْعُ وَحَنَّ لِفِرَاقِهِ
7:78.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man bakā ilayhi l-jidhʿu wa ḥanna li-firāqih.
7:78.en: O Allah, bless the man for whom the palm trunk wept and sighed at its separation from him.

7:79.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مَنْ تَوَسَّلَ بِهِ طَيْرُ الْفَلَاةِ
7:79.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man tawassala bihi ṭayru l-falāh.
7:79.en: O Allah, bless him of whom the birds of the desert sought influence.

7:80.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مَنْ سَبَّحَتْ فِي كَفِّهِ الْحَصَاةُ
7:80.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man sabbaḥat fī kaffihi l-ḥaṣāh.
7:80.en: O Allah, bless the man who held stones in his hand and which glorified Allah.

7:81.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مَنْ تَشَفَّعَ إِلَيْهِ الظَّبْيُ بِأَفْصَحِ الْكَلَامِ
7:81.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man tashaffaʿa ilayhi ḍ-ẓabyu bi-afṣaḥi l-kalām.
7:81.en: O Allah, bless him of whom the gazelles sought intercession, in articulate speech.

7:82.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مَنْ كَلَّمَهُ ‖ الضَّبُّ فِي مَجْلِسِهِ مَعَ أَصْحَابِهِ الْأَعْلَامِ
7:82.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man kallamahu ḍ-ḍabb fī majlisihi maʿa aṣḥābihi l-aʿlām.
7:82.en: O Allah, bless him to whom the lizard spoke at an open conference of the most learned (or with his most learned companions).

7:83.en: O Allah, bless the devoted evangelist.

7:84.en: O Allah, bless the brilliant lamp.

7:85.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مَنْ شَكَا إِلَيْهِ الْبَعِيرُ
7:85.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man shakā ilayhi l-baʿīr.
7:85.en: O Allah, bless the man to whom the camel made its complaint.

7:86.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مَنْ تَفَجَّرَ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصَابِعِهِ الْمَاءُ النَّمِيرُ
7:86.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man tafajja ra min bayni aṣābiʿihi l-māʾu n-namīr.
7:86.en: O Allah, bless the man for whom the sparkling water burst forth from his fingertips for his Companions.

7:87.en: O Allah, bless him who was pure and yet purified.

7:88.en: O Allah, bless the light of lights.

7:89.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مَنِ انْشَقَّ لَهُ الْقَمَرُ
7:89.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā mani nshaqqa lahu l-qamar.
7:89.en: O Allah, bless him for whom the moon opened out.

7:90.en: O Allah, bless him who was good and who did good.

7:91.en: O Allah, bless the Apostle who was given the privilege of access.

7:92.en: O Allah, bless the spreading dawn.

7:93.en: O Allah, bless the brilliant star.

7:94.en: O Allah, bless the trusty handle.

7:95.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى نَذِيرِ أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ
7:95.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā nadhīri ahli l-arḍ.
7:95.en: O Allah, bless the monitor of the people of earth.

7:96.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى الشَّفِيعِ يَوْمَ الْعَرْضِ
7:96.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sh-shafīʿi yawma l-ʿarḍ.
7:96.en: O Allah, bless him who intercedes for the Day of Visitation.

7:97.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى السَّاقِي لِلنَّاسِ مِنَ الْحَوْضِ
7:97.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā s-sāqī li-n-nāsi mina l-ḥawḍ.
7:97.en: O Allah, bless him who gives mankind drink of the cistern.

7:98.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى صَاحِبِ لِوَاءِ الْحَمْدِ
7:98.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibi liwāʾi l-ḥamd.
7:98.en: O Allah, bless the standard-bearer of praise.

7:99.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ ‖ صَلِّ عَلٰى الْمُشَمِّرِ عَنْ سَاعِدِ الْجِدِّ
7:99.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā l-mushammir ʿan sāʿidi l-jidd.
7:99.en: O Allah, bless him who bared his arm to the elbow to shoot with zeal (for Thy service).

7:100.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى الْمُسْتَعْمِلِ فِي مَرْضَاتِكَ غَايَةَ الْجُهْدِ
7:100.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā l-mustaʿmali fī marḍātika ghāyata l-juhd.
7:100.en: O Allah, bless him who was a student of Thy Will to the utmost of his power.

7:101.en: O Allah, bless the sealing Prophet.

7:102.en: O Allah, bless the sealing envoy.

7:103.en: O Allah, bless the chosen and unswerving man.

7:104.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى رَسُولِكَ أَبِي الْقَاسِمِ
7:104.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā rasūlika Abī l-Qāsim.
7:104.en: O Allah, bless Thy Apostle Abou Qasim.

7:105.en: O Allah, bless the man of many signs.

7:106.en: O Allah, bless the author of true guidance.

7:107.en: O Allah, bless the author of advice.

7:108.en: O Allah, bless the worker of wonders.

7:109.en: O Allah, bless the designer of evidences.

7:110.en: O Allah, bless the originator of plain evidence.

7:111.en: O Allah, bless the author of miracles.

7:112.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى صَاحِبِ خَوَارِقِ الْعَادَاتِ
7:112.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibi khawāriqi l-ʿādāt.
7:112.en: O Allah, bless the author of unusual customs.

7:113.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مَنْ سَلَّمَتْ عَلَيْهِ الْأَحْجَارُ
7:113.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man sallamat ʿalayhi l-aḥjār.
7:113.en: O Allah, bless the man who was greeted by stones.

7:114.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مَنْ سَجَدَتْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ الْأَشْجَارُ
7:114.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man sajadat bayna yadayhi l-ashjār.
7:114.en: O Allah, bless the man in whose presence the trees did obeisance.

7:115.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مَنْ تَفَتَّقَتْ مِنْ نُورِهِ الْأَزْهَارُ
7:115.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man tafattaqat min nūrihi l-azhār.
7:115.en: O Allah, bless the man at whose light the flowers open.

7:116.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مَنْ طَابَتْ ‖ بِبَرَكَتِهِ الثِّمَارُ
7:116.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man ṭābat bi-barakatihi th-thimār.
7:116.en: O Allah, bless the man at whose blessing the fruits mature.

7:117.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مَنِ اخْضَرَّتْ مِنْ بَقِيَّةِ وَضُوئِهِ الْأَشْجَارُ
7:117.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man ikhḍarrat min baqiyyati wudhūʾihi l-ashjār.
7:117.en: O Allah, bless the man whose left over ablution water turned the trees green.

7:118.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مَنْ فَاضَتْ مِنْ نُورِهِ جَمِيعُ الْأَنْوَارِ
7:118.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man fāḍat min nūrihi jamīʿu l-anwār.
7:118.en: O Allah, bless the man at whose light all other lights burst forth.

7:119.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مَنْ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ تُحَطُّ الْأَوْزَارُ
7:119.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man biṣ-ṣalāti ʿalayhi tuḥaṭṭu l-awzār.
7:119.en: O Allah, bless the man on prayer to whom lightens our every sinful load.

7:120.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مَنْ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ تُنَالُ مَنَازِلُ الْأَبْرَارِ
7:120.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man biṣ-ṣalāti ʿalayhi tunālu manāzilu l-abrār.
7:120.en: O Allah, bless the man, on prayer to whom the most convenient lodgings are granted.

7:121.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مَنْ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ يُرْحَمُ الْكِبَارُ وَالصِّغَارُ
7:121.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man biṣ-ṣalāti ʿalayhi yurḥamu l-kibār wa ṣ-ṣighār.
7:121.en: O Allah, bless the man, on prayer to whom the great and the small find mercy.

7:122.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مَنْ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ نَتَنَعَّمُ فِي هٰذِهِ الدَّارِ وَفِي تِلْكَ الدَّارِ
7:122.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man biṣ-ṣalāti ʿalayhi natanaʿʿamu fī hādhihi d-dār wa fī tilka d-dār.
7:122.en: O Allah, bless him, on prayer to whom we shall find things well and pleasant, in this sojourn and in that.

7:123.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مَنْ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ تُنَالُ رَحْمَةُ الْعَزِيزِ الْغَفَّارِ
7:123.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man biṣ-ṣalāti ʿalayhi tunālu raḥmatu l-ʿAzīzi l-Ghaffār.
7:123.en: O Allah, bless the man, on prayer to whom there will be awarded the mercy of the Mighty and Merciful Lord.

7:124.en: O Allah, bless the beloved conqueror.

7:125.en: O Allah, bless the chosen and honoured man.

7:126.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ
7:126.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin.
7:126.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad.

7:127.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مَنْ كَانَ إِذَا مَشَى فِي الْبَرِّ الْأَقْفَرِ تَعَلَّقَتِ الْوُحُوشُ بِأَذْيَالِهِ
7:127.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man kāna idhā mashā fī l-barri l-aqfar taʿallaqati l-wuḥūshu bi-azyālihi.
7:127.en: O Allah, bless the man who when he was travelling in the most desert lands, the wild creatures actually clung to the skirts of his robe.

7:128.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيمًا وَالحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
7:128.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi wa ṣaḥbihi wa sallim taslīman wa l-ḥamdu lillāhi rabbi l-ʿālamīn.
7:128.en: O Allah, bless him and his Family and his Comrades, and give them perfect peace, and praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds.

7:129.ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ عَلٰى حِلْمِهِ بَعْدَ عِلْمِهِ وَعَلٰى عَفْوِهِ بَعْدَ قُدْرَتِهِ
7:129.tr: Al-ḥamdu li-Llāhi ʿalā ḥilmihi baʿda ʿilmihi, wa ʿalā ʿafwihi baʿda qudratihi.
7:129.en: Praise be to Allah for his indulgence as the fruits of His knowledge, and for His Forgiveness as the outcome of His Power.

7:130.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ ۞ وَمِنَ الذُّلِّ إِلَّا لَكَ وَمِنَ الْخَوْفِ إِلَّا مِنْكَ ۞ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَقُولَ زُورًا ۞ أَوْ أَغْشَى فُجُورًا ۞ أَوْ أَكُونَ بِكَ مَغْرُورًا ۞ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَمَاتَةِ الْأَعْدَاءِ، وَعُضَالِ الدَّاءِ، وَخَيْبَةِ الرَّجَاءِ، وَزَوَالِ النِّعْمَةِ، وَفُجَاءَةِ النِّقْمَةِ
7:130.tr: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina l-faqri illā ilayka, wa mina dh-dhulli illā laka, wa mina l-khawfi illā minka, wa aʿūdhu bika an aqūla zūran, aw aghshā fujūran, aw akūna bika maghrūran, wa aʿūdhu bika min shamātati l-aʿdāʾi, wa ʿuḍāli d-dāʾi, wa khaybati r-rajāʾi, wa zawāli n-niʿmati, wa fujāʾati n-niqmati.
7:130.en: For, O Allah, I take refuge with Thee for poverty's sake only to Thee, and for humility to Thee alone, and for fear from Thee alone; and I appeal to Thee whether I speak falsehood, and whether I indulge in wickedness, or whether I am presumptuous with Thee: and I appeal to Thee for the jealousy of the enemies and for the difficulties of misery, and to save the disappointment of my hopes and the loss of pleasure, and the fell effect of vengeance.

7:131.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ، وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا مَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ حَبِيبُكَ (3)
7:131.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa sallim ʿalayhi, wa-jzihi ʿannā mā huwa ahluhu ḥabībuka. (3)
7:131.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, and give him peace and reward him as much as he deserves, he who is Thy Beloved. (3)

7:132.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ، وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا مَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ خَلِيلُكَ (3)
7:132.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma wa sallim ʿalayhi, wa-jzihi ʿannā mā huwa ahluhu khalīluka. (3)
7:132.en: O Allah, bless our master Abraham and give him peace, and reward him as much as he deserves, he who is Thy Friend. (3)

7:133.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ وَرَحِمْتَ وَبَارَكْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي الْعَالَمِينَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ ۞ عَدَدَ خَلْقِكَ وَرِضَاءَ نَفْسِكَ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِكَ
7:133.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā ṣallayta wa raḥimta wa bārakta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma fī l-ʿālamīna innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd, ʿadada khalqika wa riḍāʾa nafsika wa zinata ʿarshika wa midāda kalimātika.
7:133.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, and the Family of our master Muhammad, even as Thou hast blessed and shown mercy and favour towards our master Abraham in the worlds; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious throughout all Thy creation, and in the pleasure of Thy Soul, and the embellishment of Thy Throne, and the form of Thy Words.

7:134.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ
7:134.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada man ṣallā ʿalayhi.
7:134.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in every one who blesses him.

7:135.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ
7:135.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada man lam yuṣalli ʿalayhi.
7:135.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in every one who does not bless him.

7:136.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا صُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ
7:136.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā ṣulliya ʿalayhi.
7:136.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad as many times as he has been blessed.

7:137.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ أَضْعَافَ مَا صُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ
7:137.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin aḍʿāfa mā ṣulliya ʿalayhi.
7:137.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad twice in everything that is blessed in him.

7:138.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ
7:138.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā huwa ahluhu.
7:138.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad as much as he deserves.

7:139.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا تُحِبُّ وَتَرْضَى لَهُ
7:139.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā tuḥibbu wa tarḍā lahu.
7:139.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad even as Thou lovest and favourest him.
